turns.text:
Sure, let's break this down simply. A USSE address is like a special way to tell your email program where to find your emails. It uses all the important parts of the address, like your name, the company’s name, and the part that shows what type of mail server it is. An IMAP address is a bit different; it tells your email program to check for new mail at a central place.

Using a USSE address is better because it gives your email program all the information it needs right away, so it can fetch your emails faster and without any confusion. This is like giving clear directions to a friend so they know exactly where to go.

The term ‘USSE’ comes from the words “User,” “Server,” and “Store.” It’s a way to make sure all the parts of the address are there, making it easier for your email program to understand where to find your messages.
